    <h1>Teaching</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="teaching-intro">
    <p>Kai has taught and supported students in data science, causal inference, mathematics and statistics at Wharton, EPFL, and Imperial College London.</p>
    <p>His teaching experience to date spans head-TA responsibilities, course support, office hours and grading, as well as small-group peer tutoring, including the creation and delivery of bespoke learning materials.

    He has also worked as a mentor to several high school students with ambitions to reach elite universities in both the UK and US, <a href="https://www.zerogravity.co.uk"> including those from disadvantaged backgrounds </a>.
    </p>
  </div>
